rev.t:
Had a pretty good experience at Sky Garden overall — I’d rate it around a solid 4 to 4.5 stars.
The ambience is decent, not overly lavish or “wow,” but still comfortable enough …
I’ve visited this place twice. The drinks are decent, and the food is good as well. It has a small dance floor right next to the dining area, which adds to the overall vibe.

Worst Experience – Definitely Not Worth the Hype

This was one of the most disappointing dining experiences I've had. …
